entry_points.title: conversation-conditioned two-speaker pilot
entry_points.question: Can conversation-aware turn direction produce a convincing two-speaker exchange where isolated line direction does not?
entry_points.finding: All twelve turn files were unique and passed the frozen mechanical duration checks. The isolated and conversation-aware assemblies were 12.61 and 13.25 seconds respectively.

entry_points.title: contrastive-focus instruction-form ablation
entry_points.question: Does removing the competing focus word from Qwen's instruction restore directional contrastive emphasis?
entry_points.finding: All eight frozen outputs were distinct, complete, and mechanically valid. The owner-local admission review found natural-sounding examples in the set, but no output could honestly be judged both natural and directionally correct. Neither positive-only nor context-only instruct…

entry_points.title: Selected Poems real-media ingest (v0.1.0)
entry_points.question: Can the packaged file and simulated-stream ingestion paths produce consistent prosodic metadata from real spoken audio when transcription remains an external step?
entry_points.finding: Four of seven recordings (57.1%) were processed, totaling 571.931 seconds (9m 31.9s) and 1,065 transcribed words.
